from pathlib import Path
programs=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference-3/play/users/u000/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
test=[[0,9,3,3,1,5],[7,5,3,3,1,7],[3,3,3,3,9,2],[2,4,0,7,3,3],[4,3,5,3,3,3],[3,3,3,3,3,3]]
code='''def transform(grid):
    n = len(grid)
    cw = [[grid[n - 1 - c][r] for c in range(n)] for r in range(n)]
    ccw = [[grid[c][n - 1 - r] for c in range(n)] for r in range(n)]
    half = [[grid[n - 1 - r][n - 1 - c] for c in range(n)] for r in range(n)]
    return [grid[r] + cw[r] for r in range(n)] + [ccw[r] + half[r] for r in range(n)]
'''
p=programs/'task-94be54a5.py'; p.write_text(code)
ns={}; exec(compile(p.read_text(),str(p),'exec'),ns)
